chunks.content: Omoikane Innovations Pvt. Ltd. is a product-driven technology company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. The company focuses on indigenous design and development of electronic hardware, advanced embedded systems, autonomous platforms, and defense-grade solutions for aerospace, defense, and industrial applications. Slogan: 'Indigenous technology · Global standards'. Tagline: 'Innovation is not our goal; it’s our standard.'

Vision: To be a trusted contributor and global leader in indigenous defense and embedded technologies by delivering high-performance, reliable, and scalable systems suitable for mission-critical industries. Mission: To design, develop, and deliver advanced products and platforms across Aerospace, Defense, and Industrial domains—enabling scalable technology integration and licensing worldwide for a safer, smarter, and self-reliant future. Values: Innovation, integrity, excellence, teamwork, and customer focus ('Your mission. Our engineering').

OFC-X is an advanced, high-performance, reliable, and flexible autonomous flight controller designed for demanding UAV and unmanned aerial platform applications. Key specifications and design architecture include: STM32 and AT32 microcontroller (MCU) platform options; multiple I/O and sensor interfaces for flexible payload and actuator integration; real-time precision flight control algorithms; system integration and interface customization for OEM UAV manufacturers.

chunks.section: Products — OESC-60 / OESC-100 Electronic Speed Controller
chunks.content: OESC-60 / OESC-100 is a high-efficiency, high-current 4-in-1 Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) platform engineered for multirotor propulsion systems and extreme operational demands. Specifications: Available in 60A (OESC-60) and 100A (OESC-100) current variants; supports 6S to 12S LiPo battery platform voltages; equipped with advanced current monitoring and thermal protection mechanisms; built for heavy-lift drones and multirotor propulsion efficiency.

OGN-X is a high-precision satellite positioning and navigation architecture engineered for autonomous UAV navigation, mapping, and defense platforms. Specifications: Multi-constellation GNSS options (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou/NavIC); RTK-ready (Real-Time Kinematic) architecture for centimeter-level positioning accuracy; compact, ruggedized enclosure and integration designed for demanding airborne environments.

OCOM-X is a reliable, secure communication system architecture for connected autonomous systems and unmanned operations. Specifications: RF (Radio Frequency) and LTE cellular integration options; secure, encrypted data link architecture for telemetry, control, and payload transmission; low-power design approach ensuring extended mission endurance for airborne and ground platforms.

Aerospace capabilities at Omoikane Innovations: Design, integration, and development of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms, flight control systems (OFC-X), avionics, RF communication modules (OCOM-X), and multirotor propulsion control (OESC). Engineered for precision, aerodynamic stability, real-time control loops, and mission-critical reliability in airborne operations.

Defense capabilities at Omoikane Innovations: Secure, encrypted communication systems; autonomous surveillance platforms for ground and aerial situational awareness; ruggedized defense-grade embedded electronics hardened for extreme field conditions; intelligent real-time sensor processing and decision support.

Automotive capabilities at Omoikane Innovations: Intelligent automotive electronics; Electronic Control Unit (ECU) solutions; real-time embedded computing for next-generation vehicle automation, powertrain telemetry, driver assistance, efficiency, and vehicle safety.

Railways & Industrial Systems capabilities: Predictive maintenance systems using AI-driven sensor monitoring to prevent equipment failures; industrial automation hardware; intelligent control systems for rail networks and large-scale manufacturing facilities.

Core engineering disciplines at Omoikane Innovations: 1. Hardware Design (system architecture, schematics, multi-layer high-speed PCB layout); 2. Embedded Platforms (MCU/SoC selection, bare-metal and RTOS firmware, board bring-up); 3. RF & GNSS (wireless telemetry, antennas, satellite positioning); 4. Power Electronics (ESC architecture, power management, thermal dissipation); 5. System Integration (cabling, electromechanical integration); 6. Prototyping & Validation (functional checks, environmental stress testing, test benches).

Engineering design tools, simulation environments, and workflows used at Omoikane Innovations: ECAD & Layout: OrCAD, Cadence Allegro, Altium Designer, PADS; Circuit Simulation: LTspice; Structural & Aerodynamic Simulation: ANSYS (FEA stress and CFD aerodynamic modeling); Mechanical Design: SolidWorks, CATIA, Fusion 360; Workflows: Formal Design Reviews, DFM (Design for Manufacturing), DFT (Design for Testing).

Omoikane Innovations serves high-reliability markets: UAV Manufacturers & Drone OEMs, Defense & Aerospace Contractors, Government Agencies, Industrial Automation Firms, Agriculture & Survey Providers, and System Integrators.

Open Role: Embedded Hardware Design Engineer (Full-time, Bengaluru, India). Responsibilities: Design and develop schematics and multi-layer PCB layouts for UAV, aerospace, defense, and industrial electronics; component selection and BOM creation; cross-functional bring-up and prototyping; hardware debugging with oscilloscopes and diagnostic benches; following DFM, DFT, and reliability practices. Desired Skills: OrCAD / Allegro or Altium Designer; analog, digital, and power electronics; high-speed signal integrity, layer stack-up, and manufacturing constraints.

Open Opportunity: Engineering Internship – Hardware / Embedded Systems (Early Career, Bengaluru, India). Focus: Project-based hands-on learning and mentorship working on real aerospace, UAV, and defense embedded hardware. Activities: Schematic review, lab testing, board bring-up, component soldering, and firmware testing. How to Apply: Send resume to omoikaneinnovations@gmail.com or info@omoikaneinnovations.com with subject 'Internship Enquiry'.
